R4B1T H0L3 Motion Board

R4B1T H0L3 motion board

Key poses for every action, rendered from the exact production SVG on main. The new states are poses only, made by transforming a proposed wrapper layer; no path, colour or proportion changes. MENU and BLIND are captured from the approved animations at real timestamps. Approve or adjust the motion language here before any production code changes.

State priority

  1. BLIND DESCENT
  2. ROLL
  3. RESULT
  4. Secondary: replay › topology › branch › trail › history, then copy on top
  5. MENU
  6. idle

Transform ownership, outer to inner

r4h-blind-* › r4h-roll-* › r4h-result-* › r4h-act-* › r4h-copy-* › r4h-menu-* › r4h-idle-* › r4h-entrance-* › master. One new secondary layer (15 wrappers) serves all six sheet states, since only one sheet is open at a time, plus a 3-wrapper copy layer nested inside it. Two of the 15, r4h-act-glance-left/right, carry TRAIL's eye glance alone so TRAIL can return its eyes last.

Motion strength

  1. Quiet: MENU, COPY TRAIL, eyes and one ear or paw, ≤ 5 px
  2. Medium: BRANCH, TRAIL, TOPOLOGY, HISTORY, REPLAY; head, ears, one or two paws, ≤ 22 px travel, hole only in BRANCH
  3. Strong: ROLL, RESULT, BLIND; whole body, the hole, occlusion

Shared rules

Eyes lead, body follows, ears land last. Hard ease-out on recognition, no springs, overshoot only where already approved. Nothing loops while a sheet is open. Every state sets classes only; none changes selection, commitment, reveal, trail, history, topology, proof or navigation.

MENU

.menu-openquiet
Trigger
App opens the menu sheet.
Start pose
Canonical.
Anticipation
Right highlight pulls back a hair (0–40 ms).
Primary action
Highlight glances 5 px right / 3 px down toward MENU; sideways ear dips 3.5°, 50 ms later.
Hold
Held while open. Nothing loops.
Return
Eye returns first (130 ms); ear follows 80 ms later (240 ms).
Approx. duration
Open ≈ 310 ms · close ≈ 320 ms.
SVG groups affected
r4h-menu-glint, r4h-menu-ear
Transform ownership
r4h-menu-* (existing, approved and unchanged). Proposal: no head attitude change, to keep MENU the quietest reaction.
Reduced motion
No reaction; canonical pose while open.

BRANCH

.branch-openmedium
Trigger
App opens the branch sheet.
Start pose
Canonical (or whatever MENU has left; MENU yields its glance).
Anticipation
Eyes snap sideways toward the forward side, 5 px (0–90 ms, hard ease-out).
Primary action
Sideways ear swings 4° toward it, head leans 5 px / 1.5°, right paw reaches 22 px to the rim edge; the hole gives one short one-sided stretch (scale-x 1.035 from its left edge) and returns (90–300 ms).
Hold
Alert branching pose held while open (slightly relaxed: ear 3.5°, paw 18 px). Hole canonical. No preference cue: the pose points at "another path", not at a choice.
Return
Eyes first, then head and paw (≈ 280 ms), ear last (+60 ms).
Approx. duration
Enter ≈ 300 ms · return ≈ 340 ms.
SVG groups affected
r4h-act-glint-left/right, r4h-act-ear-right, r4h-act-head, r4h-act-paw-right, r4h-act-hole(+front), r4h-act-backing
Transform ownership
r4h-act-* (one secondary-action layer; sits under RESULT, above MENU)
Reduced motion
Hold pose appears immediately (no hole stretch); canonical immediately on removal.

TRAIL

.trail-openmedium
Trigger
App opens the trail sheet.
Start pose
Canonical.
Anticipation
Eyes go backward (left) first (0–100 ms).
Primary action
Head follows, 4 px / −1.5° (100–260 ms). Left paw slides back along the rim, 22 px; the existing artifact edges up from behind the rim beside it, tilted, its lower half still under the lip (260–520 ms).
Hold
Held while open: artifact half-exposed at the rim, never raised or presented. Reads as a record lying where the rabbit has been.
Return
Artifact sinks behind the rim first, then paw, head, eyes (≈ 320 ms nominal; measured ≈ 366 ms, inside the 380 ms canonical-return contract). TRAIL is the only peer that returns eyes last; the eye glance rides its own wrapper so the shared eyes-first schedule stays unchanged for the others.
Approx. duration
Enter ≈ 520 ms · return ≈ 320 ms.
SVG groups affected
r4h-act-glance-left/right (TRAIL-only eye glance, inside r4h-act-glint-*), r4h-act-head, r4h-act-paw-left, r4h-act-card (inside RESULT’s card slot), r4h-act-backing
Transform ownership
r4h-act-* (one secondary-action layer; sits under RESULT, above MENU). Card: act lifts it only while RESULT is not holding it; RESULT keeps sole ownership of its slot.
Reduced motion
Hold pose with the artifact already at the rim; removed instantly.

TOPOLOGY

.topology-openmedium
Trigger
App opens topology.
Start pose
Canonical.
Anticipation
Ears split into two listening directions, long ear −7°, sideways ear −5° (0–140 ms).
Primary action
Eyes scan left (140–300 ms), then right (300–480 ms) while the body rises 12 px above the hole and the paws spread 16 px to opposite rim points, staying on the rim.
Hold
Controlled hold while open: risen 10 px, ears split, eyes centred. No network drawing, no "best path" cue.
Return
Eyes centre, body lowers and paws close together (≈ 300 ms), ears settle last (+80 ms).
Approx. duration
Enter ≈ 480 ms · return ≈ 380 ms.
SVG groups affected
r4h-act-ear-left/right, r4h-act-glint-left/right, r4h-act-rabbit, r4h-act-paw-left/right, r4h-act-backing
Transform ownership
r4h-act-* (one secondary-action layer; sits under RESULT, above MENU)
Reduced motion
Hold pose immediately (no scan); canonical immediately on removal.

HISTORY

.history-openmedium
Trigger
App opens session history.
Start pose
Canonical.
Anticipation
Eyes move first: back and slightly up (0–100 ms).
Primary action
Head turns backward 6 px / −3° (100–280 ms); the long ear follows late, −6° (200–420 ms). No paw, no artifact: that is the difference from TRAIL.
Hold
Short hold (≈ 200 ms), then canonical return while the sheet stays open. One-shot; does not re-trigger while open.
Return
Eyes, head, then long ear last (≈ 300 ms).
Approx. duration
≈ 900 ms total, one-shot.
SVG groups affected
r4h-act-glint-left/right, r4h-act-head, r4h-act-ear-left
Transform ownership
r4h-act-* (one secondary-action layer; sits under RESULT, above MENU)
Reduced motion
No motion (a one-shot glance has no lasting state to show).

REPLAY / INSPECT

.replay-openmedium
Trigger
App opens replay / inspection.
Start pose
Canonical.
Anticipation
Eyes drop and narrow (scale-y 0.9) (0–120 ms). The body never moves and the hole never reacts, which is what separates it from ROLL.
Primary action
Right paw reaches down behind the rim (clipped) while the head tilts toward it (120–380 ms); it brings the existing artifact up close to the face, tilted, and the eyes stay on it rather than the viewer (380–620 ms).
Hold
One deliberate second look: eyes flick off the artifact and back (620–900 ms), then held inspecting while open.
Return
Artifact goes back behind the rim with the paw, then head, eyes open last (≈ 380 ms).
Approx. duration
Enter ≈ 900 ms · return ≈ 380 ms.
SVG groups affected
r4h-act-glint-left/right, r4h-act-eyes, r4h-act-head, r4h-act-paw-right, r4h-act-card, r4h-act-backing
Transform ownership
r4h-act-* (one secondary-action layer; sits under RESULT, above MENU). RESULT presents to the viewer; REPLAY keeps the eyes on the evidence.
Reduced motion
Inspecting hold pose immediately; removed instantly.

COPY TRAIL

.copy-trailquiet
Trigger
App adds the class for one copy action and removes it (≥ 420 ms later).
Start pose
Canonical, or the TRAIL hold if the trail sheet is open.
Anticipation
Artifact at the right paw; paw tightens 3 px (0–80 ms). If nothing is presented, the artifact is lifted to the paw for the duration.
Primary action
Left paw crosses to touch the artifact (80–180 ms); one short separation, 7 px / −3° (180–260 ms). No flash, no checkmark.
Hold
None.
Return
Paws home; the artifact drops back behind the rim unless TRAIL or RESULT is holding it (260–420 ms).
Approx. duration
≈ 420 ms, one-shot.
SVG groups affected
r4h-copy-card, r4h-copy-paw-left/right (small layer nested inside the act layer, so COPY can play on top of the TRAIL hold)
Transform ownership
r4h-copy-* (proposed, nested inside r4h-act-*).
Reduced motion
No motion.

BLIND DESCENT

.blind-descendingstrong
Trigger
App starts a blind descent.
Start pose
Canonical.
Anticipation
Lock: eyes narrow (0–90 ms); the hole widens before the rabbit moves (90–220 ms); highlights drop out downward (180–300 ms).
Primary action
9 px drop with ears lagging (290–330 ms), claws grip the rim (330–420 ms), head pulled under (420–540 ms), claws release (540–605 ms), sideways ear goes, long-ear tip alone (620–700 ms), gone at 700 ms. Clipped by the rim; nothing fades or scales to zero.
Hold
Rabbit absent; wordmark and hole remain; hole closes with a slight overshoot (700–880 ms). Nothing loops.
Return
See climb-out below.
Approx. duration
880 ms.
SVG groups affected
r4h-blind-* (existing, approved, unchanged)
Transform ownership
r4h-blind-* (existing). Highest priority; the act layer is switched off while it runs.
Reduced motion
Rabbit absent immediately.
